summary: Frontend-only visual verification of the Andrea Leški news image crop fix on homepage '/' at 1920x1080, plus regression of the enrollment teaser CTA flow. All 3 requested checks PASS. Image 1 (alt='Demonstracija vtopa z izravnoteženjem') has inline objectPosition '50% 32%' (computed '50% 32%', object-fit: cover) and the region screenshot confirms the two standing judoka (full upper bodies + heads) are visible instead of feet/empty mat. Both news images render side-by-side (top=380.25 for both, left 512 vs 972), each 436x320 (h-80), grid scrollWidth==clientWidth (896) and scrollHeight==clientHeight (320) => no overflow/distortion. Enroll teaser renders; CTA navigates to /kontakt#vpis, kontakt-enroll-section (id='vpis') visible and scrolled to viewport top (offset 79.75px, below fixed header). No console errors, 0 error elements.

issues: Minor/cosmetic only: the judoka's heads sit near the very top edge of the 320px crop band (~30px of headroom). Crop is acceptable and matches the fix intent; a slightly smaller offset (e.g. 50% 28%) would add breathing room but is not required.
